titulo_ru: За час, через час, в течение часа
intro: It indicates the time needed to complete something; черечас, how much is missing; в течение часа, the period during which it occurs.

frases.es: Leí el informe en una hora.

frases.es: El tren saldrá dentro de una hora.
frases.en: The train will be off in an hour.

bloques.pregunta: What is the expression «within an hour»?

opciones.explicacion: The fact is set an hour later.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
